title: Alpha One — event payout.settled v1
description: V1 catalog event `payout.settled` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = LED-08 (settlement posting), DOC-04 (receipt), ANA-01. Derived from: docs/11 §4.1 (payout.settled — Decision 6, renamed from the sheet's PayoutPaid by D60, docs/58) + docs/32 `payout_executions` (provider, reference, amount, timestamp, actor). Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.

reference.description: payout_executions.reference (the provider's transfer ref — 'proof it actually left', docs/11 §3.3)
